say:1:1621529001:1.text: We've won... and it's all because of you, my friend.
say:1:1621529001:1.source_cn: 我们赢了……但这多亏了你，狼阁下。
say:1:1621529001:1.male: We've won... and it's all because of you, my friend.
say:1:1621529001:1.female: We've won... and it's all because of you, my friend.

say:2:1621529002:1.text: Your magic clearly outclasses Meowris. Honestly, I think the world could be yours if you wanted it…
say:2:1621529002:1.source_cn: 没想到你的魔法能如此碾压喵丽丝，实话说，我觉得只要你愿...
say:2:1621529002:1.male: Your magic clearly outclasses Meowris. Honestly, I think the world could be yours if you wanted it…
say:2:1621529002:1.female: Your magic clearly outclasses Meowris. Honestly, I think the world could be yours if you wanted it…

say:3:1621529003:1.text: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!
say:3:1621529003:1.source_cn: 但你没有那样做，反而选择挺身而出阻止她——这才是真正的...
say:3:1621529003:1.male: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!
say:3:1621529003:1.female: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!

choice_prompt:4:1621529003.text: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!
choice_prompt:4:1621529003.source_cn: 但你没有那样做，反而选择挺身而出阻止她——这才是真正的正直与荣耀。能和你并肩作战，是我的荣幸！
choice_prompt:4:1621529003.male: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!
choice_prompt:4:1621529003.female: You could have seized power after defeating Meowris, but you didn't... That shows your true righteousness, and I'm honored to be your ally!

say:5:1621529004:1.text: You're the very epitome of a true hero, my friend!
say:5:1621529004:1.source_cn: 狼阁下……你的气度，简直就是英雄中的英雄！
say:5:1621529004:1.male: You're the very epitome of a true hero, my friend!
say:5:1621529004:1.female: You're the very epitome of a true hero, my friend!

say:6:1621529006:1.text: One more thing... Even though we won convincingly, I know Meowris won't give up so easily.
say:6:1621529006:1.source_cn: 不过……即便是一场碾压的决斗，凭我对喵丽丝的了解，她绝...
say:6:1621529006:1.male: One more thing... Even though we won convincingly, I know Meowris won't give up so easily.
say:6:1621529006:1.female: One more thing... Even though we won convincingly, I know Meowris won't give up so easily.

say:7:1621529007:1.text: Like the wind, she may have died down today, but that doesn't mean she won't come back tomorrow.
say:7:1621529007:1.source_cn: 她就像风，哪怕今天停了，明天依旧可能卷土重来。
say:7:1621529007:1.male: Like the wind, she may have died down today, but that doesn't mean she won't come back tomorrow.
say:7:1621529007:1.female: Like the wind, she may have died down today, but that doesn't mean she won't come back tomorrow.

say:8:1621529008:1.text: So, we shouldn't be too quick to let our guard down.
say:8:1621529008:1.source_cn: 所以，我们不能松懈，我们的小队必须永远保持警觉。
say:8:1621529008:1.male: So, we shouldn't be too quick to let our guard down.
say:8:1621529008:1.female: So, we shouldn't be too quick to let our guard down.

say:9:1621529009:1.text: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?
say:9:1621529009:1.source_cn: 你愿意继续支持我，对抗未来的风暴吗？
say:9:1621529009:1.male: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?
say:9:1621529009:1.female: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?

choice_prompt:10:1621529009.text: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?
choice_prompt:10:1621529009.source_cn: 你愿意继续支持我，对抗未来的风暴吗？
choice_prompt:10:1621529009.male: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?
choice_prompt:10:1621529009.female: Would you be willing to face more challenges ahead with me?

say:11:1621529010:1.text: With you around... I feel like I can handle anything.
say:11:1621529010:1.source_cn: 有你这句话……我就不怕任何风暴了。
say:11:1621529010:1.male: With you around... I feel like I can handle anything.
say:11:1621529010:1.female: With you around... I feel like I can handle anything.

say:12:1621529011:1.text: It's reassuring to know I won't be alone when Meowris makes her comeback.
say:12:1621529011:1.source_cn: 无论喵丽丝什么时候卷土重来，我知道，我不是一个汪。
say:12:1621529011:1.male: It's reassuring to know I won't be alone when Meowris makes her comeback.
say:12:1621529011:1.female: It's reassuring to know I won't be alone when Meowris makes her comeback.

say:13:1621529016:1.text: When everyone else told me to give up, you were the only one who believed in me. That teaches me one thing...
say:13:1621529016:1.source_cn: 当初很多动物都劝我放弃，只有你坚定地支持我，这让我相信——
say:13:1621529016:1.male: When everyone else told me to give up, you were the only one who believed in me. That teaches me one thing...
say:13:1621529016:1.female: When everyone else told me to give up, you were the only one who believed in me. That teaches me one thing...

say:14:1621529017:1.text: A true king is defined by an unyielding spirit.
say:14:1621529017:1.source_cn: 真正的王，是那份永不熄灭的意志。
say:14:1621529017:1.male: A true king is defined by an unyielding spirit.
say:14:1621529017:1.female: A true king is defined by an unyielding spirit.

say:15:1621529018:1.text: I want all animals to understand this! A king isn't a specific animal. If we're ready, we can all be the kings of our own lives!
say:15:1621529018:1.source_cn: 所以，我就是要证明给所有动物们看！王不是某只动物！我们...
say:15:1621529018:1.male: I want all animals to understand this! A king isn't a specific animal. If we're ready, we can all be the kings of our own lives!
say:15:1621529018:1.female: I want all animals to understand this! A king isn't a specific animal. If we're ready, we can all be the kings of our own lives!

say:18:1621529013:1.text: I'll do the same for you!
say:18:1621529013:1.source_cn: 不过下一次，由我来挡在你面前才是！
say:18:1621529013:1.male: I'll do the same for you!
say:18:1621529013:1.female: I'll do the same for you!

choice:10:1:2.text: I'll protect you when she returns.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 等她再来，我还会挡在你前面
choice:10:1:2.male: I'll protect you when she returns.
choice:10:1:2.female: I'll protect you when she returns.

say:19:1621529014:1.text: Peace is just the time to catch our breath before the next battle.
say:19:1621529014:1.source_cn: 没错，和平只是下一场战斗前的深呼吸。
say:19:1621529014:1.male: Peace is just the time to catch our breath before the next battle.
say:19:1621529014:1.female: Peace is just the time to catch our breath before the next battle.

say:20:1621529015:1.text: We must be ready at all times for the next challenge.
say:20:1621529015:1.source_cn: 我们必须时刻做好下一次迎风而上的准备。
say:20:1621529015:1.male: We must be ready at all times for the next challenge.
say:20:1621529015:1.female: We must be ready at all times for the next challenge.

choice:10:2:3.text: Indeed, we haven't reached the finish line.
choice:10:2:3.source_cn: 你说得对，和平从不是终点
choice:10:2:3.male: Indeed, we haven't reached the finish line.
choice:10:2:3.female: Indeed, we haven't reached the finish line.

say:21:1621529005:1.text: Woof! You're a real class act!
say:21:1621529005:1.source_cn: 汪！这才是我心中真正的英雄！
say:21:1621529005:1.male: Woof! You're a real class act!
say:21:1621529005:1.female: Woof! You're a real class act!
